scope: Exploratory method optimization on previously inspected course populations. Nested source-only tuning is not a fresh external validation.
selection_rule: Maximize source middle-course macro recall at 20 percent capacity. Exact numerical ties (1e-12) prefer fewer deviations from source-fixed, then source-validation-only, structural, full; then stronger alpha, larger margin, full pool. Freeze every outer task before any target evaluation.

feature_definitions.source_validation: Candidate source-validation mean recall; no target descriptor and no utility regression. Alpha/margin do not apply; one distinct setting per pool.
feature_definitions.structural: Ridge utility prediction using the first four existing unlabeled descriptors: log target sample size, capacity, feature missingness, zero-click share.
feature_definitions.full: The four structural descriptors plus all six standardized behavioral mean shifts. Source utility labels train Ridge in both descriptor modes.
